title: Polynomial-size circuit characterization
statement: For every language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet, $L$ can be recognized by a family of Boolean circuits of fan-in at most two whose size is bounded by a polynomial in the input length if and only if there exists such a family whose recognized language is exactly $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
